text:
Ava: quick sync — need to lock format for the webinar next Tue. leaning toward a 35–40m session with a short live demo. want everyone to weigh in on tradeoffs.
Diego: +1 for shorter talk, more live demo time. attendees love operational stories.
Priya: agree but we should reserve 10m for benchmarks narrative + callouts on cost/latency. not just raw numbers.
Eli: demo ops note — if we do live model calls we need a throttling fallback. prefer recorded demo + live Q&A with canned prompts.
Maya: sales wants a 5m customer case highlight and a CTA to book a Dedicated trial. can we fit that?
Ava: thinking grid: 1) Full live demo (risk: flakiness) 2) Recorded demo + live commentary (lower risk) 3) Hybrid: recorded core + 3 live prompts. Which one is preferred?
Diego: hybrid sounds balanced. recorded for model warm-up + 3 live prompts to show routing/fallback.
Priya: hybrid -> also want a 2-slide benchmark story: methodology + one example prompt showing cost delta after caching/quantization. keep it simple.
Eli: for hybrid demo ops: ops checklist below — please react with :thumbsup: if OK.
rehearsal-bot: Scheduled rehearsal slots opened: Mon 09:00, Mon 13:00, Tue 08:00. RSVP to this thread.
Ava: ops checklist (paste into notes):
```
- Warm-up: run recorded demo once on staging, capture token counts
- KV/cache priming step: run prefix prompt X (script in /demo/scripts/prime.sh)
- Fallback routes: model B (quantized) & region fallback enabled
- Network test: simulate 200 rps burst for 30s
- Presentation: slide deck opens to slide 4 (benchmarks) at T+12m
- Customer clip: 90s pre-recorded customer highlight queued at T+25m
- Rehearsal: full run with switching to recorded flow at T+15m
```
Priya: include the benchmark snippet below in slides (short):
```
- Prompt: "Summarize user session and recommended actions"
- Baseline: open-model-1 @ p99 latency 450ms, cost $0.012/token
- Opt: +kv-cache +q4 -> p99 220ms, cost $0.007/token (~42% cost reduction)
```
Maya: CTA wording idea: "Try Redwood Dedicated: predictably fast inference — book a trial" -> we should A/B test CTA on landing page.
Diego: we'll do final copy A/B in the registration flow. two variants: demo-first vs econ-first.
Eli: one more ops note — tag @eng-oncall before the live demo start, include rollback command in a pinned message.
Ava: agreed. who can take owner for rehearsal Monday 13:00?
Priya: I can run content flow and slides.
Eli: I'll do demo ops and run the network test.
Diego: I'll own the landing page CTAs and the benchmark slide visuals.
Maya: I'll coordinate sales follow-up and the Dedicated trial CTA.
Ava: perfect. @rehearsal-bot please add Mon 13:00 to calendar for Ava/Priya/Eli/Diego/Maya.
rehearsal-bot: Added event "Webinar full rehearsal" Mon 13:00 — invites sent.
Ava: final question — we need a 1-line abstract for the event page by EOD today. draft: "How to serve LLMs at production scale: tradeoffs, benchmarks, and a demo of routing/fallbacks that keep apps online." feedback?
Diego: concise. maybe swap 'serve' -> 'operate' to appeal to infra folks.
Priya: try: "Operate LLMs at production scale: benchmarks, routing strategies, and a resilient demo."
Maya: +1. sales-friendly and clear.
Ava: great — finalizing. thanks team, see you at rehearsal. :party-parrot:
